outer_split: same deterministic Ensembl-target holdout as Experiments 011-013
inner_cross_fitting: 5 target-group folds for all three derived observer outputs and channel-local statistics

observers.name: additive
observers.features: scores, evidence presence, pipeline availability, evidence/availability counts; no pairwise interactions

observers.name: interaction
observers.features: additive features plus pairwise score and evidence-presence interactions

observers.name: empirical_bayes
observers.features: smoothed observed evidence-presence state within the currently available pipelines; beta-binomial shrinkage strength 35

naive_committee: six biological channel embeddings plus three observer embeddings are averaged into one 16D shared state before the 16x16 ganglion
routed_committee: biological channels are averaged; three observer embeddings are mixed by a learned softmax gate using pipeline availability, evidence density, mean observed score, each observer entropy and observer disagreement; biological and observer mixtures each contribute 50% before the ganglion
evaluation: complete evidence and every combination with 1,2,3 biological pipelines unavailable
important_note: early naive channel-removal diagnostics that changed the averaging denominator were discarded and are not treated as evidence; reported routing evidence uses observer-only profiles and learned gate weights.
